newsitem.title: FRANCE: Usinor unit in deal with Atlas Steels.
newsitem.headline: Usinor unit in deal with Atlas Steels.

text.p: Europe's largest steelmaker, Usinor Sacilor, said on Monday its Ugine subsidiary had granted exclusive distribution rights for stainless steel in Australia and New Zealand to Australia's Atlas Steels Ltd.
The deal follows plans announced by Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd in September to shut its stainless steel operations at Unanderra, Australia, Usinor said in a statement.
"This agreement grants Atlas the role of exclusive distribution partner for flat and long stainless steel products in Australia and New Zealand," it said.
It did not disclose the deal's value.
Atlas Steels Ltd is the largest stainless steel distributor in the two countries with 14 sites, Usinor said.
Previously publicly quoted, the commpany was bought out last year by the Australian appliance and electrical products manufacturer Email.
The French steel firm said the distribution deal betweeen Ugine and Atlas would get under way in 1997.
Until then, both would use the "necessary means" to delivery quantity, quality and service to their clients, it said.
